contract.negotiation: api capabilities; additive revision compatibility, not exact package-version matching

ui_submission.root_cause: Start had only in-memory UI evidence before admission, kill-on-drop CLI lifetime, and failures hidden behind the Management renderer. Backend-only operation lists could not expose pre-admission outcomes.
ui_submission.storage: Private launch-intents beside UI preferences, scoped to backend root
ui_submission.process: Detached one-shot public-CLI submitter, immutable attempt marker, original request ID retained
ui_submission.operations: Local pending/failed/uncertain entries merged with authoritative backend receipts by original request ID
ui_submission.reconciliation: One read-only status reconciliation for missing local entries; no automatic resend
ui_submission.historical_attempt: Outcome remains unknown without its original admission evidence; no cancellation claim or retry

fixture_assertions: same-turn native steering acknowledgement during automatic compaction
compaction connection remains open until fixture releases it
input absent from compaction request and present in later continuation
dedicated compaction rejection -32600 with compact discriminator; compaction continues
passive turn lookup covers both host fixtures, active/terminal/empty/racing turns and preserved stop tokens
UI submission viewer process exits before/during/after admission; original attempt survives and is not replayed
local absent/failed/lost-ack records survive reopen and backend merge

client_steps: Adopt the exact verified backend artifact without restarting the compatible shared owner.
Negotiate turn_observation.version=1. For explicitly requested current-turn following use turn-target, then bind checkpoints to its exact returned turn/runtime/catalog identities.
Never retarget an old receipt checkpoint stream after checkpoint_stale_turn or attribute new-turn text to a prior send/Steer.
Treat dedicated compact/review rejection as no native acceptance; require a fresh explicit action and fresh target after it. Do not replay the rejected ID against another turn.
Automatic compaction uses native pending input; no downstream speculative queue, force/cancel fallback or immediate-response promise.
Preserve every existing uncertain/cancelled/blocked receipt; upgrading does not replay it.
limitations: Native preflight metadata does not expose compact-task kind; final native pre-admission rejection remains possible.
Current-turn lookup still requires a verified retained live attachment and fresh bounded native evidence.
Checkpoint updates are turn-associated public snapshots, not causal Steer replies or consumption/completion evidence.
Synthetic process-lifetime tests are not a real provider launch acceptance run.
The earlier unrecorded UI Start outcome cannot be reconstructed solely by this repair.
